portholeomnis.online_mode.tooltip.on: Verify guests with Mojang. Only players who own the game can join, under their own accounts.
portholeomnis.online_mode.tooltip.off: No account check. Your world is open to the internet and anyone can join under any name — including people you never gave the code to.
portholeomnis.use_porthole.tooltip.on: Bring up the tunnel and post the share code to chat — friends can join over the internet.
portholeomnis.use_porthole.tooltip.off: Plain LAN: the world stays visible on your local network only, no tunnel is started.
portholeomnis.force_relay.tooltip: Route through Valve relays. Hides your IP from guests at the cost of some latency.
portholeomnis.lobby.title: Porthole lobby
portholeomnis.connect.title: Join via Porthole
portholeomnis.connect.exited: Porthole exited. Check the code and try again.
portholeomnis.connect.timeout: The tunnel did not come up in time. Is the host still online?
portholeomnis.porthole.not_found: Porthole not found. Install it from Steam.
portholeomnis.porthole.unsupported_os: Porthole has no macOS build: Steam ships it for Windows and Linux/SteamOS only.
portholeomnis.porthole.steam_not_running: Steam is not running. Porthole needs a running, signed-in Steam client.
